theorems.name: Submission.pit_integral_closedBall_rescale_tendsto
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (h : Euclid n → ℝ) (b : Euclid n) (R : ℝ), 0 < R → Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => ⨍ a in closedBall b s, h a ∂volume) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => ∫ c in closedBall (0 : Euclid n) R, h (b + r • c) ∂volume) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
